chapter.verse: Ka Pasian leh ka Kumpi aw, nangmah hong pahtawi-in a tawntungin nangma min ka phatphat ding hi.
Ni simin nangmah hong pahtawi-in, a tawntungin nangma min ka phatphat ding hi.
Topa lian hi, nakpi tak-a phat ding hi a, ama liatna ngaihsut zawh ding hi lo hi.
A khang a khangin nangma nasepnate kiphatphat ding a, a vanglian na bawl nate kigengen ding hi.
Nangma liatna leh na minthan’na a lamdang nangma sepnate ka lungngaingai ding hi.
Mite in a vanglian nangma bawlnate taangko ding a, keimah in nangma liatna ka pulak ding hi.
Amaute in nangma liatna na minthan’na genkhia-in, nangma thumanna nakpi-in sa ding uh hi.
Topa dikin hehpihna nei a, hehhakin itna kip lianpi nei hi.
Topa pen mi khempeuh tungah hoih a, ama bawlsate khempeuh tungah ama hehpihna om hi.
Topa aw, nangma sepsate khempeuh in nang tungah lungdamna hong ko ding uh a, nangma misiangthote khempeuh in nangmah hong phat ding uh hi!
Amaute in na kumpi a minthan’na genin, na vangliatna thu sut ding uh a,
a vanglian nangma sepnate leh na Kumpi gam hoihna a minthan’nate mihing tate’ tungah kitheisak ding uh hi.
Na Kumpigam pen a tawntunga om kumpigam hi a, na ukna in khang tawntungin a kip hi. Topa pen ama thute khempeuh ah thutak a, a gamtatna khempeuhah hehpihna nei hi.
Topa in a puk mite khempeuh huh a, niamsakna a ngah mite khempeuh sangto sak hi.
Nuntakna a nei khempeuhte’ mit in nang hong en uh a, nangmah in a hun a tun’ ciangin amaute an na vaak hi.
Nangmah in na khut na hong a, nuntakna a nei khempeuhte’ deihna na lungkim sak hi.
Topa pen ama sepna khempeuh ah thutang a, a gamtatna khempeuh ah hehpihna nei hi.
Amah a sam mi khempeuh, lungsim tak tawh a sam mi khempeuhte kiangah, Topa nai hi.
Amah in, amah a zahtakte khempeuh’ deihna tung sak a, amaute’ kikona zong za-in amaute honkhia hi.
Topa in amah a itte khempeuh kem a, ahih hangin migilote khempeuh amah in susia ding hi.
Topa ka phat tawntung ding hi; mi khempeuh in a tawntungin ama min siangtho phat ta uh hen.
